desc: (Händelsedatum) , VIKINGATID

An incomplete copper-alloy and iron Roman Jackson type I scalpel dating from the 1st - 4th centuries. The blade and leaf shaped blunt dissector tool are missing, only the rectangular grip survives (Length 35.9mm, Width 10.7mm). The end of the grip with the key hole socket has two rolled back terminals, a fragment of the iron tang still survives within the key hole socket (Diameter 2.25mm). The rectangular block tapers to the old break where the leaf shaped terminal is now lost. The artefact has a deep green patina with lighter patches of mid-green visible.
